ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — token-service returning 502s for ~2m, error rate 18% across hosted API region-usw2 :rotating_light:
Maya (Support): acked. opening thread for customer comm templates + agent troubleshooting snippets. paging Sam and Jin. :wave:
Sam (Oncall): I'm on it. joining bridge in 2. Sending initial ack to affected customers now.
Maya (Support): copying a quick customer-facing ack we can paste into Zendesk/Intercom — feedback welcome:
Lia (CS): please keep it short, tell customers we’re investigating, and include ETA only if we have it.
Maya (Support): ZENDESK MACRO DRAFT (copy/paste):
```
Hi {{customer_name}},

Thanks for the report — we’re aware of an issue affecting token requests in US-West and some API calls may return errors or time out. Our engineering team is investigating. We’ll update you within 30 minutes or sooner with next steps.

If you can, please attach any request IDs or timestamps from your failing calls (header x-request-id or logs).

Sorry for the disruption — we’ll share a status page link shortly: https://status.redwood.example

— Maya, Support on behalf of Redwood Inference
```
Maya (Support): INTERCOM SNIPPET (shorter):
```
We’re investigating errors impacting API token requests in US-West. Engineers are on it and we’ll update soon. Apologies for the interruption.
```
Sam (Oncall): bridge created: zoom.us/j/123-456?pwd=bridge (access for oncall+eng+sre). Triage plan: 1) Confirm severity & customer impact, 2) Short-term mitigation (fallback/static-token cache), 3) Root cause triage.
Jin (SRE): early observations from logs: increased 5xx from token-service worker pods, CPU spiking on node-gpu-12, frequent OOMKill of token-proxy container. Also seeing repeated redis timeouts in the path.
Devon (Eng): I’m looking at the token-service logs and will post repro steps.
Maya (Support): quick checklist for agents replying to customers while SRE works the fix — paste into agent reply composer:
- Acknowledge receipt + apologize
- Share current status & high-level impact (e.g., token requests may fail)
- Ask for quick diagnostic items (x-request-id, exact timestamp, region)
- Tell them we’ll update within 30 minutes (or earlier if resolved)
- Offer workaround if available (e.g., retry, alternate endpoint)

Maya (Support): AGENT TEMPLATE 1 (ack + ask):
```
Thanks for reporting this, {{customer_name}}. We’re investigating an issue that may cause token request failures in US-West. Could you share a couple of sample request IDs or timestamps? That will help our engineers correlate your traffic. We’ll follow up within 30 minutes.
```

Maya (Support): AGENT TEMPLATE 2 (if customer requests ETA):
```
We don’t have a full ETA yet — engineers are actively investigating. We’ll provide the next update within 30 minutes. For urgent business impact, reply here and we’ll prioritize escalation.
```

Sam (Oncall): mitigation note for agents: if a customer is on Dedicated or Private, ask if they have failover configured and suggest switching to a pinned model endpoint in a different region if available. For Hosted customers, we’ll post a status page update and work the global fallback policy.
Jin (SRE): Troubleshooting checklist for agents (do before escalating to eng):
1) Confirm customer timestamp and x-request-id present.
2) Ask customer to try one retry with 500ms jitter.
3) If they’re using SDK, ask them to share exact SDK version.
4) Check customer region header; confirm us-west.
5) If they are seeing 401 vs 502, note it separately.

Devon (Eng): Short-run runbook commands for SRE/Eng on bridge (only paste into bridge chat):
```
# check pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=token-service -o wide
# tail logs for a pod
kubectl -n inference logs token-service-abc123 -c token-proxy -f --since=10m
# check node memory
kubectl top node node-gpu-12
# redis slowlog
redis-cli -h redis-usw2 info | grep -i used_memory
```

Jin (SRE): current mitigation: scale token-service replicas to 8 (applied), added 10s circuit-breaker on token-proxy, configured temporary traffic-shed to lower-priority tenants. Monitoring for error rate drop.
Sam (Oncall): Sam -> Maya: please run a quick status page blurb and a Zendesk macro to all open alerts. Lia, can you coordinate CS priority customers?
Lia (CS): on it. compiling a targeted notify list for customers with SLA. Sending priority email draft now.

Maya (Support): STATUS PAGE COPY (short):
```
We’re investigating elevated error rates for token requests in US-West. Engineers are actively working on mitigation. Impact: token requests may fail or return 5xx. Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have more info.
```

Maya (Support): ZENDESK BROADCAST MACRO (for open tickets):
```
Short note: We’ve identified an issue affecting token requests in US-West. Our engineers are investigating and we’re working on mitigation. We’ll update this thread shortly. If you have a current workaround, please reply here.
```

Sam (Oncall): Handoff plan if I need to go offline: put "ONCALL-ESCALATED" in thread, make sure pagerduty note has runbook link and bridge link. If the oncall rotation changes, leave a quick summary: what’s changed since start, current mitigations, and items that need attention.
Maya (Support): HANDOFF TEMPLATE FOR NEXT ONCALL (paste into handoff):
```
Summary: token-service 5xxs in us-west; scaled replicas, circuit-breaker added, error rate reduced from 18% -> 6% in last 10m. Customer impact: hosted API token requests intermittently failing; targeted notify to SLA customers sent. Next action: monitor error rate; if >10% for 15m, rollback traffic-shed or increase replicas further. Bridge: zoom.us/j/123-456. Logs: kubectl logs token-service-abc123 -c token-proxy (see runbook). Contact: Jin (SRE) on Slack.
```

Jin (SRE): note for agents — DO NOT instruct customers to change credentials or rotate keys unless asked by security. For Dedicated customers, advise their infra contact — we’ll coordinate privately.
Lia (CS): customer email draft for SLA accounts (paste to send):
```
Subject: Service impact affecting token requests (US-West)

Hi {{account_owner}},
We’re investigating an incident that may affect token request success rates in US-West. Our engineering team has applied mitigations and error rates are improving, but you may see intermittent failures. We’ll continue to monitor and share updates. If you need immediate assistance, reply and we’ll prioritize a support callback.

Sincerely,
Lia and the Redwood Support Team
```

Maya (Support): small note on tone — avoid overpromising, keep transparent, include status page link and bridge if they request tech details.
Sam (Oncall): current status: error rate trending down; will wait another 15m before marking mitigated. If no regression, we’ll start post-incident notes and root cause timeline.
Devon (Eng): pushed a small proxy fix to reduce mem spike; monitoring.

Maya (Support): CLOSURE TEMPLATE (when mitigated):
```
Hi {{customer_name}},

The issue affecting token requests in US-West has been mitigated. Engineers applied scaling and a proxy fix; error rates are back to baseline. If you continue to see issues, please reply and include any recent request IDs. We’ll share a post-incident summary soon.
```

Jin (SRE): last check: 5xx <1% over 10m window. marking incident as mitigated in our internal tracker.
Maya (Support): thanks team. I’ll update all open tickets with the closure template and prep a short post-incident comms with timeline + customer impact metrics.
Sam (Oncall): filing the handoff notes in PD and will leave the bridge open for one hour. Good job everyone. :tada:
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigation applied, error rate decreased. Incident status: MITIGATED.
Maya (Support): thread closed for follow-ups; keep any SOC/security or dedicated customer threads separate per policy.
